column3: The Hebrew leaves the maker unnamed; BSB supplies Solomon.
The Hebrew separately describes two panels of one door and two of the other; BSB combines them as two panels for each.
The Hebrew leaves the builder unnamed; BSB supplies Solomon.
The Hebrew says “the fourth year” without repeating Solomon or his reign; BSB supplies both.
The Hebrew explicitly calls it “the eleventh year” and identifies Bul as the eighth month; BSB says “his eleventh year and eighth month.” It uses “house,” where BSB uses “temple.”
